name: @inttegro/cogni-workspace
description: Workspace for Cogni predictive loading packages

scripts.build: npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-client && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-react && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-next && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-server
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:package
scripts.test: npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:integration
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:integration

author: Inttegro Eng <engineering@inttegro.com>
